This documentation is mainly for the Wallet SDK and it's usages to integrate with various SEPs.

The document is structured to be language-agnostic, but with the components listed below we can add language-specific logic into the document.

Generally, text should be applicable to all of supported programming languages, but for differences special `` component can be used (read more below)

## Wallet guide components

### Header

Every page in the guide starts with the shared header:

```mdx
import Header from "/snippets/wallet/header.mdx";

<Header />
```

It renders the language buttons (`LanguageButtons` in `snippets/wallet/language.jsx`) and a note listing the supported languages: TypeScript, Flutter (Dart), and Swift. The selected language is stored in a cookie and in Mintlify's code preference.

### Code examples

Put each language's example in a tab, with these exact titles so the tabs stay in sync with the language buttons and across the page:

````mdx
<Tabs>
<Tab title="TypeScript">

```typescript
// TypeScript example here
```

</Tab>
<Tab title="Flutter">

```dart
// Flutter example here
```

</Tab>
<Tab title="Swift">

```swift
// Swift example here
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>
````

Every tab group should have all three languages. When an example is long or reused, put it in `snippets/wallet/<ts|dart|swift>/` and import it into the tab.

For regular code examples that aren't Wallet SDK specific, use `<CodeGroup>`.
